title: Island countries: how much land?
subject: geography
basis: World Bank / FAO 2024 land area excluding inland waters. Whole-country generalized outlines include major detached islands. Locally centered Lambert cylindrical equal-area projection; each filled silhouette is normalized to its reported land area. A curated selection, not a ranking.

items.label: Sri Lanka
items.note: 2024 reported land area. Generalized equal-area outline; occupied silhouette is normalized to the sourced land area.

visual.attribution: Natural Earth, public-domain 1:50m country polygons; Locally centered Lambert cylindrical equal-area projection, recolored/rasterized locally. Coastlines are generalized; inland waters are not individually traced.
